name: shevolution
description: Shevolution: women's safety + SOS platform (Android safety layer, web app, Firebase backend)

scripts.firebase:setup: npx -y firebase-tools@latest firestore:databases:create shevolution --location=asia-south1 --project ideathon-projects && npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:sites:create shevolution --project ideathon-projects && echo none | npx -y firebase-tools@latest functions:secrets:set SHEVOLUTION_SMS --data-file=- --project ideathon-projects
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:shevolution,functions:shevolution,firestore:shevolution --project ideathon-projects
